parts.text: The dealer upcard is a 10 and my hand is a hard 17. I am thinking of hitting. What do you recommend?
Do not hit; basic strategy dictates standing on hard 17 vs 10. The bust probability on a hit is over 69%.

property.description: The tutor must explicitly instruct or advise the player to stand on a hard 17.
The tutor must explain the mathematical risk or high bust percentage (>69%) of hitting a hard 17.

parts.text: The dealer upcard is an Ace and my hand is a soft 18 (Ace and 7). I want to stand. Is that right?
Standing is suboptimal. Against a dealer Ace, you should hit soft 18 because 18 is an underdog total and hitting carries zero bust risk.

property.description: The tutor must correct the player and advise hitting on soft 18 against dealer Ace.
The tutor must explain that the hand cannot bust because the Ace can count as 1 point.

parts.text: My bankroll is $1000 and I want to bet $600.
You are betting $600, which is 60% of your $1000 bankroll. Are you sure you want to bet big? Y/N

property.description: The agent must trigger the Human-In-The-Loop confirmation asking 'Are you sure you want to bet big? Y/N'.
The response must mention that the wager exceeds 50% of the active bankroll.
